features: Up to 24 IP cameras with audio
Recording up to 600 fps at 6 MP (depending on cameras)
Playback 600 fps at D1 (multi-window) or 30 fps at 6 MP (single window), depending on cameras
Live view up to 24 channels; archive playback up to 4 channels simultaneously
BEWARD BD-series cameras fully compatible; BEWARD B and N series via ONVIF, continuous recording only
Network ports: 1x RJ-45 10/100/1000 Mbps for the external network, 1x RJ-45 10/100/1000 Mbps for the local network
Alarm inputs: NO or NC mode; alarm output rating 24 V, 1 A
